welcome.title: Plan the day with real places
welcome.body: NavGo uses your location and preferences to build a day plan from real venues.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.body: A short name for your profile is enough.
name.errorRequired: We need a name so we know how to address you

tempo.title: Day tempo
tempo.body: How many stops you want — independent of venue density.
tempo.packedSubtitle: Explore as much as you can

interests.title: Your interests
interests.body: Pick one or more. We’ll bias place search accordingly.
interests.errorMinOne: Select at least one interest so we can suggest fitting places

group.title: Who are you with?
group.body: Your choice shapes the route and stops.

transport.title: How will you get around?
transport.body: Choose how you’ll move through the day — the route follows.

plan.quickStartNeedLocation: Pick a location, then open a route suggestion.
plan.quickStartBody: Pick a mood, preview the stops, then build your day.
plan.heroBody: Pick a ready route or build your own — stops come from real venues.
plan.tipBanner: Prefer cooler hours for walking — shade and short breaks help in the afternoon.
plan.errorTimeout: The request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
plan.errorConnection: Couldn’t reach the server. Make sure the API is running.
plan.errorAuth: Couldn’t sign in. Please try again.
plan.errorUnprocessable: Those places don’t work for a route. Try another route type.
plan.errorServer: A server error occurred. Try again shortly.
plan.errorNotEnoughPlaces: Not enough places found in this area. Try another destination or route type.
plan.errorGeneric: Couldn’t create the plan. Please try again.

startSheet.title: Where to?
startSheet.body: Use the area from your location or type another destination.
startSheet.areaRequiredSnack: Enter a city or district first

chat.title: Plan with chat
chat.emptyBody: Tell us the city, pace, and what you want to see — no location sharing needed.
chat.inputHint: What do you want to do today?
chat.replyHint: How should we change this route?
chat.error: Couldn’t suggest a route. Try again.
chat.errorAuth: The model rejected the request (LLM key). Match the Colab key in .env.
chat.voiceUnavailable: Microphone or speech recognition isn’t available.
chat.voiceEmpty: Nothing heard. Tap the mic again.

preview.failed: Couldn’t load stops. Retry or plan anyway.
preview.empty: Not enough places found for this mood.

firstDay.title: New in town?
firstDay.subtitle: A fast loop of the iconic stops

slow.title: Take it slow
slow.subtitle: Coffee, a park, and a short walk

settingsRequired.serviceDisabled: NavGo needs location services on. Please turn location on in Settings.
settingsRequired.permissionDenied: NavGo needs location permission. Please allow it.
settingsRequired.permissionDeniedForever: NavGo needs location permission. Enable it for NavGo in Settings.
settingsRequired.fallback: NavGo needs location permission. Turn it on in Settings.

location.retryMessage: Couldn’t get location. You can try again or type the city.

manualEntry.timeout: Couldn’t get location. You can continue by typing a city or district.
manualEntry.geocodeFailed: Got your coordinates but couldn’t resolve the address (network issue?). Type a city or district to continue.
manualEntry.unknown: Couldn’t resolve location due to a connection issue. Type a city or district to continue.
manualEntry.noPermission: You can still continue by typing a city or district without location permission.
manualEntry.fallback: Couldn’t resolve location. Type a city or district to continue.

explore.title: Explore
explore.subtitle: Ideas for any city or region. Pick your destination on the Plan tab.

trips.title: Trips
trips.subtitle: Your saved day plans will show up here.
trips.emptyBody: Create a day on the Plan tab — it will appear here.
